classification: A calendar event is attendance at an appointment, meeting, class, practice or activity. A task is an action to complete, such as submitting homework, buying milk or taking out bins. A deadline or reminder time alone does not make a task a calendar event. Ask if ambiguous. Never invent missing facts.

questions.title: What is the appointment or activity?
questions.time: What time does it start? Include AM or PM.
questions.whether this should be a task or calenda: Is this a task to complete or a calendar activity to attend?
questions.which parent will drive: Which parent will drive, or is transportation not needed?
questions.who will pick up: Who will pick up? You can also say Undecided.

instructions: Keep previous confirmed fields when interpreting a follow-up. Ask for one missing required field at a time. Preserve any end time and notifications provided. Location and end time are optional in this version; do not invent them. Completion means draft ready for review, never booked, sent or executed.
